Name: Final Fantasy VII Bike Horse Replacer
Author: SardonicSeriph
Description:
This mod replaces the horse with the bike from Final Fantasy VII.

The bike's appearance is based off of the look from the original game, because I like that version.

It's an XNB for two reasons. Partially because I made it for a friend and I's personal multiplayer save. Hello Cloud, you know who you are. I want to keep the save mostly vanilla for the sake of said friend's sanity. I also just can't be bothered to make a content patcher version. [s]If anyone wants to create and upload a content patcher version, go ahead.  [/s]

Content patcher version now available [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29285]here[/url], thank you yehudirs.

Would go well with a mod that changes the horse sound effects, like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10077]this one.
[/url]

HOW TO INSTALL XNB MODS:

1. Download the mod MANUALLY, not with any mod manager

2. Unzip the file. Take a look at the contents.

3. Find the Stardew Valley game folder. On the Steam version on Windows, this can be done by right clicking the game in the Steam library, mousing over "manage" in the dropdown, and clicking "browse local files" in the next dropdown.

4. Find and enter the "Content" folder. It is a file folder, not a file.

5. Find and enter the appropriate file folder. For this mod specifically, that is the "Animals" Folder.

6. Find the file that is being replaced, and move it to a safe backup folder. The file will share a name with the file inside the unzipped mod folder. For this mod, that is the horse.xnb file.

7. Open the Unzipped mod, and drop the file inside into the appropriate folder. Dropping the folder inside will not work.

Congratulations, you have now installed a Stardew Valley mod the old-fashioned way.

To uninstall:

1. Open the appropriate folder.
2. Open the folder containing the file that was backed up, because Nexus users always read all of the instructions.
3. Drag the original file into the appropriate folder, and allow it to replace when prompted.
3.5 In the event that the original file was not backed up, deleting the modded file and verifying file integrity on Steam will replace it.
